mapper.select: select id, serial_number name from scm_purchase_order where purchase_status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `scm_purchase_order` WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 and DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m%d')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `scm_purchase_order` WHERE DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m%d')

SELECT p.*, s.name as supplier_name, s.bank_name as supplier_bank_name, s.bank_account as supplier_bank_account,
(select IFNULL(sum(actually_payment_amount),0) from contract_supplier_payment where bool_delete_enum = 0 and audit_status = 2 and order_id = p.id and property_type in (1, 4) ) as payment_amount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract_supplier_payment WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND audit_status = 1 AND order_id = p.id AND property_type in (1, 4) ) AS un_check_payment_count,
(select IFNULL(sum(invoice_amount),0) from contract_supplier_invoice where bool_delete_enum = 0 and audit_status = 2 and order_id = p.id and property_type in (1, 4) ) as invoice_amount,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract_supplier_invoice WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND audit_status = 1 AND order_id = p.id AND property_type in (1, 4) ) AS un_check_invoice_count,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract_supplier_settlement WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND audit_status = 1 AND order_id = p.id AND order_class in (1, 2) ) AS un_check_settlement_count,
(SELECT IFNULL(sum(amount),0) FROM contract_supplier_settlement WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND audit_status = 1 AND order_id = p.id AND order_class in (1, 2) ) AS un_check_settlement_amount, c.name as branchCompanyName
FROM scm_purchase_order as p LEFT JOIN scm_supplier as s on s.id = p.supplier_id AND s.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_branch_company AS c on c.id = p.branch_company_id AND c.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND c.enabled = 1
WHERE p.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND p.purchase_type = #{purchaseType}
AND date(p.create_time) >= #{startDate}
AND date(p.create_time) <= #{endDate}
AND p.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0
and p.supplier_id = #{supplierId}
and s.name like CONCAT('%',#{supplierName},'%')
and p.serial_number like CONCAT('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
and p.settlement_status = #{settlementStatus}
and find_in_set(#{projectId},p.project_ids)
order by p.create_time desc

SELECT spo.supplier_id, ss.name as supplier_name, SUM(spo.amount) AS amount FROM scm_purchase_order AS spo INNER JOIN scm_supplier AS ss ON spo.supplier_id = ss.id AND ss.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE spo.bool_delete_enum = 0
and ss.name like concat('%',#{supplierName},'%')
and date(spo.create_time) >= date(#{startDate})
and date(spo.create_time) <= date(#{endDate})
GROUP BY spo.supplier_id
select * from scm_purchase_order where bool_delete_enum = 0 and find_in_set(#{projectId}, project_ids)
SELECT count(*) FROM scm_purchase_order WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 and find_in_set(#{classId}, aux_material_ids)

SELECT spo.*, spo.supplier_id 'supplier.id', ss.name 'supplier.name' FROM scm_purchase_order AS spo LEFT JOIN scm_supplier AS ss ON spo.supplier_id = ss.id AND ss.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE spo.bool_delete_enum = 0
and DATE_FORMAT(#{year}, '%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(spo.create_time, '%Y')

select spo.* from scm_purchase_order spo left join scm_supplier ss on ss.id=spo.supplier_id where spo.bool_delete_enum = 0 and spo.bool_temporary_storage = 0 and spo.data_status !=0 and spo.project_attribute = 1
and DATE_FORMAT(spo.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTime[0]},'%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(spo.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{createTime[1]},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT p.amount, p.basic_class, p.settlement_amount, p.branch_company_id, c.`name` as branch_company_name FROM scm_purchase_order AS p LEFT JOIN sys_branch_company AS c ON c.id = p.branch_company_id AND c.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND c.enabled = 1 where p.bool_delete_enum = 0
and p.id = #{orderId}

SELECT spo1.* FROM scm_purchase_order spo1 JOIN ( SELECT spo.pass_parent_id FROM scm_purchase_order spo JOIN wms_approve_record war ON spo.id = war.data_id WHERE war.STATUS = 1 AND war.approve_process_type = 20018 ) AS subquery ON spo1.id = subquery.pass_parent_id WHERE spo1.serial_number = #{serialNumber};

select material_type, count(1) as numbers, sum(amount) as amount from scm_purchase_order where bool_delete_enum = 0 and bool_temporary_storage = 0 and data_status !=0 and review_status = 2 and bool_detail = 1 and material_type is not null
and branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, "%Y")=DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
group by material_type

select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, "%Y-%m") as dateTime, count(1) as numbers, sum(amount) as amount from scm_purchase_order where bool_delete_enum = 0 and bool_temporary_storage = 0 and data_status !=0 and review_status = 2 and bool_detail = 1
and branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, "%Y")=DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
group by dateTime

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT( create_time, "%Y-%m" ) AS dateTime,
DATE_FORMAT( create_time, "%Y-%m-%d" ) AS dateTime,
material_type, supplier_id, sum( amount ) AS amount FROM scm_purchase_order WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 and bool_temporary_storage = 0 and data_status !=0 AND review_status = 2 AND bool_detail = 1
and branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId}
AND DATE_FORMAT( create_time, "%Y" )= DATE_FORMAT( #{yearDate}, "%Y" )
AND DATE_FORMAT( create_time, "%Y%m" )= DATE_FORMAT( #{yearDate}, "%Y%m" )
GROUP BY dateTime, material_type, supplier_id

select material_type, COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_id) as numbers, sum(amount) as amount from scm_purchase_order where bool_delete_enum = 0 and bool_temporary_storage = 0 and data_status !=0 and review_status = 2 and bool_detail = 1 and material_type is not null
and branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, "%Y")=DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
group by material_type

select b.material_type, a.name as supplierName, a.social_code, a.create_time, a.supplier_classification from scm_supplier a right join ( SELECT material_type, supplier_id FROM scm_purchase_order WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 and bool_temporary_storage = 0 and data_status !=0 AND review_status = 2 AND bool_detail = 1
and branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, "%Y")=DATE_FORMAT(#{yearDate}, "%Y")
GROUP BY material_type, supplier_id )b on a.id = b.supplier_id order by b.material_type desc,a.create_time desc
mapper.update: update scm_purchase_order set bool_delete_enum = 0 where id = #{id}
update scm_purchase_order set order_place = `level` where order_place is null
